records.transcript:
Dear Requester,

Thank you for your emails to the Bute Collection at Mount Stuart.  As you are aware we are unable to respond to enquiries at this time and this will be reviewed in January 2027 due to staffing levels.  The research spaces are fully booked between now and Christmas.

The archive material held is approximately 50% catalogued and none of the draft lists being worked through are available externally.  However, on this occasion, and as a courtesy, a basic search of the holdings has been undertaken (30 minutes of searches free of charge – which have now been done) and there were no results for the documents you are interested in.

The Mountjoy Ltd collection is privately owned and is part of the uncatalogued area of the wider collection.  Therefore, identifying specific documents would be a very lengthy process if only to identify whether or not specific records are held within this collection.  Under GDPR, we are unable to advise whether anyone has asked to inspect, borrow or receive any documents from this collection.

Thank you for your enquiry.

Kind regards,

The Collections Team





Mount Stuart Trust Ltd., a Scottish Registered Charity, No. SC009584 | Registered Office: 5 Atholl Crescent, Edinburgh, [postcode redacted] | A Company Limited by Guarantee, Company No. 118464

records.transcript:
Hi Requester, 

Hope your well and apologies for the delay in response. 

Would it be possible to help me know where/how you located this form on the Council's website please? The contact relates to my pre-decessor and the word document has subsequently been replaced via the below online web form - 

https://valeofglamorgancouncil-customerportal.achieveservice.com/en/AchieveForms/?form_uri=sandbox-publish://AF-Process-a7564af5-14e1-40ee-87d9-2a3bc3dc5bef/AF-Stage-b1f7ae81-4534-405f-befa-27d62c1bb5be/definition.json&redirectlink=/en&cancelRedirectLink=/en&consentMessage=yes&noLoginPrompt=1

The wording used in the previous e-mail is fine. In terms of timings, once a request is received, we (in conjunction with the Chair) aim to screen requests within 5 working days so that they can be considered as quickly as possible to allow preparations for any agreed item to be included as part of the next available agenda, which in this case would be 1st December.

Best,
James

-----Original Message-----
From: Requester <[email redacted]> 
Sent: 02 November 2026 22:46
To: Langridge-Thomas, James <[email redacted]>
Subject: Re: Scrutiny Topic Suggestion / Task and Finish request - Council-held planning, heritage and public-authority record for Great House Farm / Tÿ Mawr, Llandough

Dear James,

Thank you for your email of 26 October, and for recommending the county-wide records topic for consideration by the Place Scrutiny Committee.

I am happy to submit it through the Topic Suggestion Form. Could you please:

1. confirm that the Scrutiny Review Topic Suggestion Form on the Council's website ("Consideration for Review (Members of the Public)") is the current form, and that [email redacted], the address printed on it, is where it should go, as the form's list of committees does not include Place Scrutiny; 2. confirm whether the wording in my earlier email can be used as the submission, so that nothing is lost in transfer; and 3. let me know when topic suggestions are next considered in the work programming process, so that I can send the form in good time.

Thank you again for your help.

Kind regards,

Requester 
Royal Signals Cyber/ Electronic Warfare Professional bucklerfamily.estate
